projects.title: Pvp_Practice 1.0 Beta
projects.tagline: Custom PvP practice map — Requires VexBot mod and is totally open source.
projects.description:
Requires vexbot mod and is totally opensource.

Custom PvP practice map designed for combat training, bot duel sparring, weapon combos, and movement drills.
features: Requires VexBot mod for bot training & sparring routines
Totally open source custom PvP arena
Optimized arena layout for duels, spacing, and weapon combos
projects.installation:
1. Download the map file via the direct link.
2. Extract the folder into your Minecraft '.minecraft/saves' folder.
3. Make sure the VexBot mod is loaded in your mods directory.
4. Launch Minecraft and load the Pvp_Practice 1.0 Beta world.
